title: Measure the acquisition funnel with our own events: landing, cookie choice, sign-up, first useful action, return

source.ref: Contact, funnel and tracking audit 2026-11-19 (project thread: Plan a permission-first contact system, report https://claude.ai/artifact/3sCikNdCHC9khmwCJbubfk)

detail: Wave 3 of the permission-first contact plan (finding 7). UTM breakdowns in Vercel need a paid plan the owner will not buy (MONEY rule: no paid upgrades). Work: one module in lib/analytics names the steps (FUNNEL_STEPS: landing, cookie_choice, signup, first_action, return) with fixed names and no personal data; the cookie banner, sign-up and first-action paths emit them through the existing first-party event pipe; the admin growth funnel reads them. Never send persona or wellness data to pixels. Filed 2026-11-20 by the verification sweep: the plan named this id but no row existed.

verify.note: Fails until a lib/analytics module names FUNNEL_STEPS including cookie_choice and first_action.
